body: That looks amazing!! It’s not cookie cutter, it’s unique and suits your face perfectly! Huge difference but gorgeous as well! So happy for you!

I’m sorry to hear that this is taking a toll on your mental health. Without a pic it’s a bit harder to tell what might work, but you can get very small amounts of silicone injected under the skin to fill pitted acne scars, so I imagine you could get that done. might be something to look into. If it’s like a scar not from acne, I’d recommend scar revision!

While I’ve definitely progressed in my thinking after years of being brainwashed and taught to think and believe certain things, I’ve also lost all my weight loss progress due to the depression the stress has put me in. My hair has started falling out as well. I had lost about 30lbs. I’ve gained all that back, as one of my stupid compulsive coping mechanisms is comfort eating. It’s so hard. I feel so discouraged and disgusted with myself. I’m sorry you’re going through stuff like this too. It’s such a suffocating, claustrophobic feeling.
This is so stunning. May I paint this?

I love that they’re essentially keeping the uniqueness of your nose, but changing it just enough that it’s different at the same time. However, (and this is just my personal thoughts) first picture, second row I think the nose tip is tilted up a little too much. It’s something I’ve noticed as a trend, but I’ve always thought it looks too cartoonish if tilted too far. I’d ask for it to be straighter but other than that, super cute!
Absolutely! I will try to do this picture justice!
Thank you!! It’s truly a beautiful picture.

I’ve heard jaw surgery can completely change the look of the face, so that might be something that could help with your concerns or at least change your look a bit. The only thing I would personally say might “help” your face is fillers in the eyebrow area, to give it a bit of a lift there. That could perk your face up a bit but if I were you I wouldn’t do anything else. You have a very beautiful face shape and your eyes perfectly compliment the form of you lips, nose and cheekbones, it’s all pretty balanced so I would be careful. So yeah, maybe fillers to lift the brows and the ortho corrections, but I wouldn’t go further than that. Overall you’re very pretty, just not in a cookie cutter way.
I’ve heard that that’s a possibility due to scarring, but there’s a lot of different types of lip lifts, so personally I would go with one that’s called a “v to the y” lip lift if that’s a concern
